overview_description.description: Bookmypet is a UAE-based pet care marketplace and mobile app connecting pet owners with grooming, boarding, daycare, veterinary, walking, sitting, and pet taxi services. Operating across the UAE and KSA, the platform also offers pet food, accessories, loyalty rewards, and personalized pet management solutions, delivering convenient, technology-driven experiences for modern pet parents and trusted service providers.

product.name: Online Pet Services Marketplace
product.description: A platform that connects pet care providers with pet parents in the Gulf region, offering a variety of pet services.

product.name: Grooming Services
product.description: Provides grooming services for pets, including basic grooming, haircuts, and specialized grooming packages for different pet sizes and types.

product.name: Boarding Services
product.description: Offers boarding services for pets, ensuring they are well taken care of while their owners are away.

product.name: Daycare Services
product.description: Provides daycare services for pets, offering a safe and stimulating environment for them to socialize and play.

product.name: Veterinary Services
product.description: Offers veterinary services, including medical care and check-ups for pets.

product.name: Mobile Grooming Services
product.description: Provides mobile grooming services, bringing the grooming experience to the pet owner's doorstep for convenience.
